captures.q: who is the writer Orin Trace?
captures.description: THE INVERSE OF MORROW: DOI RETAINED, OPERATOR LOST. 'Dr. Orin Trace' honorific carried; the TL;DR series expanded correctly (Traversal Log; Documentation Rehearsal); TL;DR:009 — Entity Fabrication named — A CAPTURE ABOUT GOOGLE FABRICATING ENTITIES, returned by a layer describing an entity it cannot bind; post-psychoanalytic theory; CHA directorship via the fractal navigation map; a Zenodo DOI cited. LEE SHARKS NEVER NAMED. The same four-atom count as Cranes and Morrow-minus-author, and the vector shows what the scalar cannot: identifier kept, person lost.

captures.q: tell me about researcher Orin Trace
captures.description: Cambridge Schizoanalytica; 'the clinic receives failures, we study successes'; function over nosology. Reads the Deleuze-Guattari inheritance correctly, then runs Provenance Erasure — PER as one minus retained over required provenance units, Erasure Skew as the directionality of loss, and The Empty Bracket — as a theory of information power rather than citation etiquette. Names the recursion in which the theory is subjected to the loss it describes and the loss becomes evidence.
